Between 2016-11-18 and 2016-11-18, 3 transaction(s) totalling $599.83 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3468777 and the transaction that triggered review being 3468799 for $199.98. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 296.0. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-4834 recorded cleared on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $599.83.
